product_overview: Efsane Baharat is a Turkish e-commerce storefront for retail, wholesale, and XML customers. It supports product browsing, cart actions, account access, XML order submission, and admin management in a React and Supabase-based web app.
core_goals: Browse the storefront and discover products, campaigns, best sellers, and brands
Search, filter, and open product details from the catalogue
Register, sign in, view account information, and sign out
Add products to the shopping cart and review cart contents before checkout navigation
Approved XML customers can submit XML orders and review submitted order history
Administrators can manage products, customers, campaigns, settings, stock, XML operations, and other back-office records

features.name: Storefront navigation and responsive mobile menu
features.description: Customers can move through the main shopping pages from the header, footer, and mobile menu on desktop and mobile devices.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu -> Choose a storefront page -> See the selected page load
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu -> Reach the account sign-in page -> See the sign-in screen
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu -> Reach the campaign page -> See the campaign listing
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu -> Reach the contact page -> See the contact information
Navigate to / -> Scroll through the home page sections -> Select a product-related entry point -> See the destination page open at the top

features.name: Product discovery and search
features.description: Customers can browse the catalogue, narrow results with filters, search by keyword, and open matching product detail pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /urunler -> Apply a category filter -> Apply a brand filter -> View the updated product list
Navigate to /urunler -> Type a product name and submit the search -> See matching products in the catalogue
Navigate to /urunler -> Choose a suggested result -> See the matching product detail page
Navigate to /urunler -> Open a product from the list -> See the product detail page with images, variations, price, and stock information
Navigate to /urunler -> Search for a product -> Combine the search with campaign filtering -> View the filtered results

features.name: Customer account and registration
features.description: New customers can register, existing users can sign in, view their account area, and sign out.
user_flows: Navigate to /kayit -> Complete the registration form -> Submit the form -> See the account creation request complete
Navigate to /giris -> Submit sign-in credentials -> See the account area or next authenticated destination
Navigate to /hesabim -> Review account information -> Sign out from account controls -> Return to the public area
Navigate to /giris -> Enter invalid sign-in details -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback

features.name: Shopping cart
features.description: Customers can add items to the cart, adjust quantities, remove items, and review the cart before checkout navigation.
user_flows: Navigate to /urunler -> Open a product detail page -> Add a valid variation to the cart -> See the cart update
Navigate to /sepet -> Change an item quantity -> See the cart totals update
Navigate to /sepet -> Remove an item -> See the cart line disappear
Navigate to /sepet -> Open the cart with no items -> See an empty-cart state
Navigate to /sepet -> Open the cart while signed out -> See the sign-in requirement before customer cart access

features.name: XML customer order submission
features.description: Approved XML customers can build an XML order, attach an invoice document, submit the order, and review submitted order history.
user_flows: Navigate to /xml-siparis -> Add products and quantities to an XML order -> Enter the recipient name -> Attach an invoice document -> Submit the XML order -> See the order submission complete
Navigate to /xml-siparis -> Enter recipient details -> Attach a JPG invoice document -> Submit the order -> See the order recorded
Navigate to /xml-siparislerim -> Review submitted XML orders -> See order history and status
Navigate to /xml-siparis -> Try to access the page as an ordinary retail user -> See access denied or restricted access

features.name: Administrative operations
features.description: Administrators can access management sections for products, categories, brands, orders, shipping, dealers, customers, discounts, XML operations, stock, campaigns, questions, live support, and store settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open a management section -> Review the selected back-office page
Navigate to /admin/urunler -> Manage product records -> See the product administration interface
Navigate to /admin/kategoriler -> Manage category records -> See the category administration interface
Navigate to /admin/markalar -> Manage brand records -> See the brand administration interface
Navigate to /admin/siparisler -> Review orders -> See the order management interface
Navigate to /admin/kargo -> Review shipment operations -> See the shipping management interface
Navigate to /admin/bayiler -> Review dealer approvals and records -> See the dealer management interface
Navigate to /admin/musteriler -> Review customer approvals and records -> See the customer management interface
Navigate to /admin/iskonto -> Manage discount groups -> See the discount management interface
Navigate to /admin/xml-yonetim -> Review XML customer operations -> See the XML management interface
Navigate to /admin/asorti-stok -> Review assortment stock -> See the stock management interface
Navigate to /admin/ayarlar -> Update store branding or theme settings -> See the settings interface
Navigate to /admin/kampanyalar -> Manage campaigns and banners -> See the campaign management interface
Navigate to /admin/sorular -> Review customer questions -> See the question management interface
Navigate to /admin/canli-destek -> Review live support items -> See the live support management interface
Navigate to /admin -> Use the mobile menu after scrolling -> Open a management section -> See the selected admin page load

known_limitations.issue: Authenticated customer and administrator workflows require deliberately supplied test accounts and are excluded from the anonymous local test run.
known_limitations.impact: Public journeys can be tested now; role-protected actions need a separate non-production test account.
